_comment: Hooks for angular-plugin. PostToolUse: format and lint changed TS/HTML/SCSS/CSS files via ESLint + Prettier when present. Skips silently when not configured.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -j '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.stdout.write(json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"]["file_path"])' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.html|*.scss|*.css|*.js|*.mts|*.cts|*.mjs|*.cjs) [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"prettier"' package.json 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"eslint"' package.json 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 'n=config-protection.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" 'eslint.config.js' '.eslintrc*' 'tsconfig.json' 'tsconfig.app.json' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (eslint.config.js;.eslintrc*;tsconfig.json;tsconfig.app.json;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 'n=post-implement-check.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when the tool is absent or no run is active.
